data.body:
AC1 verified met and ticked. Child c670-c285-a0f9-4b40 merged (Gerrit 3199) delivering docs/adr/0122-similar-ticket-retrieval.md: 227 lines, per-stratum recall@5/@10 with exact two-sided McNemar on discordant queries only (semantic stratum 186 directed queries; lexical stratum reported separately, never pooled), reproducible command lines (python measure.py --paired, --paired --k 10), and the tickets-branch SHA cad39ed1289ddb5859c490c2e01612ce1edc1420 the benchmark was derived at.

AC2-AC5 remain undelivered. Per this epic's own child decomposition, the two remaining children were to be created once the ADR landed, which has now happened:
  - Index and create-time surfacing -> delivers AC2, AC3, AC4
  - Plan-review overlap on demand -> delivers AC5

Neither child exists yet. Surfacing to the operator before creating them: AC2/AC4 require a vector index plus a Bedrock embedding model ARN wired into infra/terraform, which is an infrastructure and cost commitment rather than a wind-down of the complexity-reduction program.
